test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) .Only two people sit to the right of K. Only two people sit between K and F. Only two people sit between E and H. H sits to the immediate left of K. N sits to the immediate right of L. How many people sit between G and L ?
solution: Given: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) . 1) Only two people sit to the right of K. 2) Only two people sit between K and F. 3) Only two people sit between E and H.
